newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical in new deal with AmeriNet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical in new deal with AmeriNet.

text.p: U.S. Surgical Corp said Thursday it has signed a new five-year contract to provide AmeriNet Inc with stapling, laparoscopic and suture products estimated to generate sales of about $100 million a year.
The contract is effective effective June 1 and covers more than 2,000 hospitals for which AmeriNet provides group purchasing services, the company said.
AmeriNet currently has more than 6,000 members in 50 states and sales of $3.2 billion annually, it said.
U.S. Surgical is a diversified surgical products company.
